fictional_resolution_case.module_requirements_interpretation: Each requires entry is the minimum module version in that candidate go.mod; apply Go minimal version selection to the complete hypothetical closure. All requirements under review are listed; no other module/toolchain constraints exist in this fictional case. API compatibility facts below apply only to the supplied candidates.

public_api_facts.all_runtime_compatible_candidates: The public signatures below are available in every listed candidate. Each candidate still has its listed direct and transitive Go version requirements.
public_api_facts.log_api_and_sdk: sdklog.NewLoggerProvider with WithResource and WithProcessor; sdklog.NewBatchProcessor(exporter); LoggerProvider.Shutdown(ctx) drains batch once. log API global.SetLoggerProvider exists in supplied candidates.
public_api_facts.slog_bridge: otelslog.NewHandler(scope, otelslog.WithLoggerProvider(lp)) implements slog.Handler and carries context trace/span IDs into native LogRecords. slog.SetDefault also redirects the standard log default to that handler.
public_api_facts.http_log_exporter: otlploghttp.New(ctx, WithEndpointURL(exactURL)) accepts a complete /v1/logs URL and supports HTTP/protobuf only. It reads supported environment headers. An explicit headers option overrides those environment headers.
public_api_facts.trace_metric_exporters: otlptracehttp.New and otlpmetrichttp.New accept the independent configured trace/metric HTTP routes. sdktrace.WithBatcher and sdkmetric.WithReader(NewPeriodicReader) share the same service resource.
public_api_facts.http_runtime: otelhttp.NewHandler accepts an http.Handler and operation name, supplies request context, and records HTTP server spans and metrics. runtime.Start uses the configured meter provider.
